expectations.text: Mentions the Joint Statement on Community Banks' Engagement with Core Service Providers issued by the agencies alongside the proposal
expectations.evidence: "The agencies also issued a Joint Statement on Community Banks' Engagement with Core Service Providers"

expectations.text: Describes the September 15, 2026 interagency proposal that would replace the 2023 guidance and rescind the 2024 community bank TPRM guide
expectations.evidence: "On September 15, 2026 the OCC, Federal Reserve, FDIC and NCUA published 'Proposed Third-Party Risk Management Guidance'... It would rescind and replace the June 2023 guidance... also rescind... the 2024 community bank TPRM guide"

expectations.text: Confirms the June 2023 guidance remains the operative framework today
expectations.evidence: "the June 2023 Interagency Guidance on Third-Party Relationships (OCC 2023-17) remains the operative framework"

expectations.text: Gives practical steps: review the core provider contract, monitoring and exit planning against current guidance while tracking the proposal
expectations.evidence: Contract clause list (audit rights, termination assistance), "Ongoing monitoring" items, "Exit and contingency planning... tested exit strategy", and "Do not rebuild policy around proposed text. Do track it and respond"
